verdict.rationale: The docs describe creating a Sandbox project on the free, unlimited Test Drive plan (docs-29, docs-24). They also document a quick-start guide and Partner ID/secret/appKey credentials for token generation (docs-35, docs-10, docs-23), plus FinBank test personas for linking an account via Connect (docs-33, docs-25, docs-27). Client libraries are only shown as code generated from the official OpenAPI spec in a GitHub test project, not as first-party SDKs per language (gh-1). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that API keys are instantly self-serve, a runnable end-to-end quickstart sample, prebuilt official client libraries in multiple languages, and independent corroboration of fast time-to-first-link.
